description: UniProt reviewed (Swiss-Prot) human protein entries for a gene symbol: accession, protein name, gene, sequence length and the curated function summary. Human only (taxon 9606). Up to 5 entries per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_string_protein_networks when you need STRING protein-protein interaction partners for a human. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
